description:
The alleged hijacker of the Flydubai flight from Dubai to Tel Aviv likely wanted to target Israel’s Ben Gurion Airport, the country’s main international gateway, according to an Israeli official and an Israeli source familiar with the matter.

Hamam al-Hammami, the suspect in the hijacking attempt and co-pilot on board the flight, was stopped by the actions of the captain and several passengers who restrained him and wrested control of the airplane.

The official and the source said Israel is receiving updates from the Emiratis and that the investigation was still in its early stages. There are still questions about the suspect’s intentions, they added.

author: CNN
description:
Dozens of people were reported to be in isolation after a Russian laboratory worker at an institute dedicated to studying the plague and other infectious diseases died of an undisclosed illness. The researcher, a 28-year-old female laboratory technician at the Irkutsk Research Anti-Plague Institute of Siberia, in the town of Shelekhov, died after being diagnosed with a pneumonia of “unknown” origin, according to Rospotrebnadzor, the Russian agency that handles infectious disease.

The World Health Organization says the public health risk is low, and US Secretary of State Marco Rubio has said he doesn't think there is cause for alarm. Rospotrebnadzor has played down the link between the death of the researcher — named in local media as Darya Shipilova — and her work. Nevertheless, the agency’s head, Anna Popova, traveled to the region on Friday, according to the local governor, Igor Kobzev, for what he described as an extraordinary meeting of the regional anti-epidemic commission.

0:0
title: Russian gov't downplays plague lab worker death; dozens quarantined

description:
As the Supreme Court's new term begins Monday, Associate Justice Samuel Alito confirmed to CBS News that he thinks about retirement "every term," but that he thinks he "can still make a valuable contribution," and that he'd reconsider every year.

CNN chief Supreme Court analyst Joan Biskupic breaks down Alito's comments and addresses what may happen if Democrats gain control of the Senate in the 2026 midterm elections and if President Trump would have the opportunity to make a fourth nomination to the high court. She also examines public opinion of the Court and Trump's attacks on justices.

The source familiar called the latest threat a “real world incident.” It is unusual that the US military would move the bombers back to their home stations instead of deploying them to another base in the region, the official said. 

CNN’s Matthew Chance reports from London. Also, CNN military analyst Cedric Leighton and CNN national security analyst Alex Plitsas break down the impact on US military readiness as the conflict with Iran remains unresolved.
